cifar10.note: holdout = n held-out test images vs the full train split; test split caps n at 10,000 so n=50,000 is extrapolated, not measured. The three points follow C/n closely (max log residual 0.028, n*floor constant to 8%), so the extrapolation is trustworthy.

mnist.note: holdout = n held-out test images vs the full train split; test split caps n at 10,000 so n=50,000 is extrapolated, not measured. The points do NOT follow a power law (max log residual 0.289, n*floor ranges 9840-15565), so extrapolated_n50000 is unreliable and should not be quoted.
